Format: a screenshot of the SMS history on Helen's flip phone. When: @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE} or @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01 · What They Took}, when Helen shows the phone.

Foreshadows: the relationship between David and Helen, and David's guilt. The last message raises a question: how did David know something was going to happen?

Truth: Helen never replied. On November 9, one of Montgomery's contacts at the port warned that someone had requested surveillance data on Helen's building. David sent the message and didn't go check. It was Gale Sentinel (@UUID[JournalEntry.j32Ohis1qKJB3jcx.JournalEntryPage.6YVCnLlyxpVum6JX]{Unlogged Gale Sentinel Data Request}). David doesn't tell anyone. If a PC asks him why he didn't go, he goes quiet; if they press, he says: “I thought I had time.”

Storyteller note: February 14 is Emily Smith's birthday (@UUID[JournalEntry.VYpDoFtqKkL7FlqL]{Emily Smith}). Helen doesn't know. David does. A PC can find out and decide whether to tell Helen.
